title: Restore packagerUrl to the maintainer profile now that ca.cloudron.io reads packageUrl
body:
<!-- aidevops:brief-schema=v2 -->

## Origin

- **Created:** 2026-11-11
- **Created by:** ai-interactive (requested by the maintainer)
- **Parent task:** none. Framework guidance fix: marcusquinn/aidevops#37825 (PR marcusquinn/aidevops#37826)
- **Blocked by:** none
- **Conversation context:** Cloudron changed ca.cloudron.io on 2026-11-11 after our forum request (Cloudron forum topic 16235, post 132750). The listing's Package link now uses `packageUrl`, falling back to `packagerUrl`; the "By" link still uses `packagerUrl`. The earlier workaround of setting `packagerUrl` to the repository is no longer needed.

## What

Point `packagerUrl` in `CloudronManifest.json` back at the maintainer profile `https://github.com/marcusquinn`, keep `packageUrl` as `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app`, and update any check that pins the current manifest's `packagerUrl` to the repository URL. Do not cut a release: the change ships with this package's next upstream-update release.

## Why

The Community Apps listing shows "By Marcus Quinn" linked to this repository instead of the maintainer profile. The live ca.cloudron.io bundle now builds the Package link from `manifest.packageUrl || manifest.packagerUrl`, so the Package link keeps opening this repository after the change, and "By" opens the profile again.

## Tier

**Selected tier:** `tier:simple`

**Tier rationale:** one manifest value and its matching test assertion, with exact old and new strings and an existing check as verification. No release, catalog, workflow or changelog changes.

## How (Approach)

### Files to Modify

- `EDIT: CloudronManifest.json` — the `packagerUrl` value.
- `EDIT: test/package-test.sh:34` — the current-manifest assertion that pins `packagerUrl` to the repository URL.

### Complete Write Surface

- **Callers/readers:** ca.cloudron.io and Cloudron dashboards read `packagerUrl` from the published `CloudronVersions.json` entry, which the catalog workflow copies from `CloudronManifest.json` only when a new version is published.
- **Writers/mutation paths:** `CloudronManifest.json` only. `CloudronVersions.json` is written by `.github/workflows/cloudron-catalog-publish.yml` on a new version; not touched here.
- **Existing verification/tests:** `test/package-test.sh:34` (at filing) pins the current manifest's `packagerUrl` to the repository URL; the catalog workflow runs this test on PRs and `main`.
- **Schemas/config:** Cloudron manifest field `packagerUrl` (URL). No schema change.
- **Generated/deployed mirrors:** published catalog entries are frozen per version; the new value appears from the next published version. No other generated copy (`rg -n packagerUrl --glob '!CloudronVersions.json' --glob '!CHANGELOG*'` at filing found only the files listed).
- **Migrations/backfills:** N/A because published `CloudronVersions.json` entries are immutable by policy, so older versions are not backfilled.
- **Cleanup/rollback paths:** revert the `CloudronManifest.json` change; no published state changes until the next release.

### Implementation Steps

1. In `CloudronManifest.json`, replace:

   ```json
   "packagerUrl": "https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app",
   ```

   with:

   ```json
   "packagerUrl": "https://github.com/marcusquinn",
   ```

   Leave `packageUrl` as `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app` and `minBoxVersion` as `10.0.0`.
2. In `test/package-test.sh` (about line 34 at filing), replace `.packagerUrl == $repo` with `.packagerUrl == "https://github.com/marcusquinn"`. Keep `.packageUrl == $repo`.

3. Run `rg -n 'packagerUrl' --glob '!CloudronVersions.json' --glob '!CHANGELOG*'` and update any other check on the current manifest that still expects the repository URL. Leave assertions about historical catalog entries unchanged.

### Hazards and Compatibility

- **Concurrency/atomicity:** N/A — single metadata value in one PR; the catalog workflow serializes publication with its concurrency group.
- **Migration/rollback:** no catalog change; revert the PR to roll back before the next release.
- **Mixed-version/backward compatibility:** already-published entries keep the repository URL; only the next published entry changes. `packageUrl` stays, so Cloudron 10 requirement and listing Package link are unchanged.
- **Idempotency/retry:** re-applying the edit is a no-op once the value is the profile URL.
- **Partial failure/recovery:** if checks fail, fix the assertion in the same PR; nothing is published.
- Do not change `version`, `CloudronVersions.json` or released `CHANGELOG`/`CHANGELOG.md` entries. Do not push a `v*` tag. With the version unchanged, the catalog workflow on `main` reconciles only and does not publish.

### Verification Before Dispatch

```bash
jq -e '.packagerUrl == "https://github.com/marcusquinn" and .packageUrl == "https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app" and .minBoxVersion == "10.0.0"' CloudronManifest.json
bash test/package-test.sh
git diff --exit-code origin/main -- CloudronVersions.json CHANGELOG
```

- **Surface mapping:** the `jq` check proves the manifest values; `test/package-test.sh` proves the updated assertion and the rest of the package contract; the `git diff` proves the catalog and released changelog are untouched.
- **Broad verification trigger:** Not required.

### Scope Boundaries

**Hard boundaries:** no release, tag, version bump, `CloudronVersions.json` edit, or edits to released changelog entries.

**AI brief owner:** the maintainer's interactive session that filed this issue.

### Files Scope

- `CloudronManifest.json`
- `test/package-test.sh`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `CloudronManifest.json` has `packagerUrl` `https://github.com/marcusquinn` and `packageUrl` `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app`.
- [ ] Existing package checks and required PR checks pass.
- [ ] Regression guard: `CloudronVersions.json`, the manifest `version` and released changelog entries are unchanged, and no `v*` tag is pushed.
- [ ] After the next published upstream-update release (outside this task), the listing's "By" link opens the profile and Package opens this repository.

## Context & Decisions

- Guidance: `~/.aidevops/agents/tools/deployment/cloudron-app-publishing-skill.md` (`packageUrl` paragraph, updated in marcusquinn/aidevops#37826).
- Maintainer decision (2026-11-11): file now and let it ship with the next upstream-update release, not a dedicated release.

<!-- aidevops:origin:interactive -->
<!-- aidevops:sig -->

title: Orbit upstream v0.3.0 is available
body:
<!-- aidevops:cloudron-package-monitor upstream-v0.3.0 -->
<!-- aidevops:brief-schema=v2 -->
## What

Upstream package `coollabsio/orbit` released `v0.3.0`; remote default-branch manifest commit `d5b7538f52bebfae670ea34ba749a385f6be9c20` records `0.2.1`.

The monitor did not build, publish, tag, deploy, or modify package source.

## Files Scope

- `CloudronManifest.json`
- `Dockerfile`
- `CHANGELOG`
- `test/package-test.sh`

## File notes

- `CloudronManifest.json`: package and upstream version metadata.
- Dockerfile: final Cloudron base image and packaged upstream artifacts.
- `CHANGELOG` (Cloudron format) and/or `CHANGELOG.md`: package release notes before any version bump.
- `test/package-test.sh`: version and digest assertions that must track the bump.

## Acceptance criteria

- Reproduce and assess the finding against current upstream and Cloudron packaging guidance.
- Update package source and tests only when the finding remains actionable.
- Run the package release preflight before proposing a tag.
- Prepare and verify the release PR, then run `cloudron-release-approval-helper.sh request <repo> <pr>`; do not merge. Merge and publication happen only after signed maintainer approval of the release issue.

## Verification

Run `cloudron-package-helper.sh preflight-release v<package-version>` after updating and testing the package.

title: Standing release policy: cloudron-orbit-app routine upstream bumps
body:
<!-- aidevops:cloudron-release-policy v1 -->
## Standing release policy

```json
{"schema":1,"kind":"cloudron-standing-upstream-release","repository":"marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app","changelog_files":["CHANGELOG","CHANGELOG.md"],"pinned_files":["Dockerfile"],"check_files":["test/package-test.sh"],"check_insertion_pattern":"\\t*assert_contains CHANGELOG(\\.md)? (\\x27[^\\x27\\x24\\x60\\\\]*\\x27|\\x22([^\\x22\\x24\\x60\\\\]|\\\\\\x60)*\\x22) \\|\\| return 1"}
```

Signing this issue authorizes routine `r924` to merge and publish **routine upstream bumps** of marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app without a per-release signature. A routine bump, checked at its exact PR head:

- links exactly one open, trusted upstream monitor finding, and `upstreamVersion` equals that finding within the same major version;
- increments only the package patch version; no other `CloudronManifest.json` field changes;
- modifies in place only the manifest, the changelog files above (additions only), the pinned files (whole-token old to new version substitution only) and the check files (version substitution of existing lines, plus inserted lines that fully match `check_insertion_pattern`);
- comes from a same-repository OWNER/MEMBER PR against `main` with terminal-green checks, including preflight, no auto-merge and no `needs-maintainer-review`.

Every other release still needs `sudo aidevops approve issue <request> marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app` on its release request. Close this issue to revoke the policy; any edit or comment makes the signature stale. Add `needs-maintainer-review` to a release PR to stop the policy for that PR.

### Publication boundary
This is an approval-only issue, not a worker task. Do not auto-dispatch. The policy never deploys an app, changes credentials or branch protection, or authorizes unrelated publication.

Maintainer command: `sudo aidevops approve issue 13 marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app`

title: Supervisor health dashboard stale: 2d1h (#4)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard at #4 last refreshed `2026-11-12T03:53:16Z` — **2d1h ago** (threshold: 2d0h). The `stats-wrapper.sh` scheduler is likely failing silently.

**Likely cause:** `stats.log` (last 20000 lines) retains 3 historical budget-stop records (`rc=124`) for this repo (stages: data-gather x2, body-publication x1; last logged timeout: 60s). These records are not time-bounded, so they do not confirm current scheduler health, and `rc=124` can come from either the per-repository budget or the shared aggregate deadline. Verify the scheduler is running; if recent stops are repository-budget stops, raise `STATS_HEALTH_REPO_TIMEOUT` / `STATS_HEALTH_RECOVERY_REPO_TIMEOUT` or investigate the slow stage.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status.

   macOS / launchd:

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

   Linux / systemd user timers:

   ```bash
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer --no-pager
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.service --no-pager
   systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager 'aidevops*'
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/.config/systemd/user/aidevops-stats-wrapper.*
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app/issues/4 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **macOS missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **Linux missing or inactive systemd timer:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so the Linux scheduler setup reinstalls and enables `aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer` and `aidevops-stats-wrapper.service` under `~/.config/systemd/user`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 4 --repo marcusquinn/cloudron-orbit-app` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.
